text: The Bureau of Indian Standards issued IS 13252:2010 on 1 January 2025.
The manufacturer shall comply with the applicable notification.
The Ministry of Environment issued the Environment Protection Act 1986.
The importer must comply with Section 12 of the applicable rules.
Electronic equipment manufactured in India must meet the applicable safety standard.
The company may face a penalty of INR 50000 for non-compliance.
The Central Pollution Control Board issued the notification on 15 March 2025.
